reason: The row and the doc call the stop 'J3 own-angle dowel stop at q3max 86 (model convention)'. The model's q3 is the cuff against link 2, two bodies that are not adjacent. The verifier measured J3's own angle (link 2 against member 3) as q3' = q3 + phi, with phi = 10.87 deg at every engaged pose (phi depends on q3 alone), so the groove must be cut at q3' = 96.87. A groove cut at own angle 86 reads 11.22 fast and 12.36 near-touch, against 9.56 (the verifier's fit-bench sweep). The modelled number is that of a buildable own-angle stop, so the CLAUDE.md stop rule holds in physics. But the headline label is in the model's convention, and a CAD built from the label would build the worse design.
